speaker: Penny
text: Okay, I'll get those drinks ready for you. Sheldon, what the hell are you doing?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Is it behind you? I'm trying to get these tables cleared. We're slammed.

speaker: Penny
text: No, wait, wait, no, wait, what are you doing here?

speaker: Sheldon
text: A reasonable question. I asked myself, what is the most mind-numbing pedestrian job conceivable? And three answers came to mind. A toll booth attendant, an Apple Store genius,

speaker: Sheldon
text: and what Penny does. Now, since I don't like touching other people's coins, and I refuse to contribute to the devaluation of the word genius, here I am.

speaker: Penny
text: So you just, you just walked in and they hired you? Just like that?

speaker: Sheldon
text: No, heavens no, since I don't need to be paid. I didn't need to be hired. I simply came in, picked up a tray, and started working for the man. Let me get that plate out of your way.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Well, is it? Just a moment ago, I had a minor epiphany regarding polymer degradation phenomenon while scraping congealed nachos off a plate. You burned a dead table ten once, there, Chad?

speaker: Penny
text: Thanks, Sheldon. Sheldon, wait, this isn't even what I do. I'm a waitress, not a busboy.

speaker: Sheldon
text: You're right, that is more than you do. Hello, I'm Sheldon. I'll be your server today. I don't recommend the salmon. I saw it in the kitchen.
